title: One TypeScript conformance suite for both Node packages
description: Engineering consequence of Stakeholder directive: transpile targets and API-first; DVC QR example, machine-readable summary (test participant XXA).

statements.label: One TypeScript conformance suite for both Node packages
statements.requirement: A single TypeScript test suite, type-checked against api/generated/ts and driven by the shared vectors, SHALL run in CI against both the Kotlin/JS npm package and the jco-transpiled Rust component, and SHALL pass on both.
